variants.headline: Grant programme passes over needy districts
variants.body: A government grant programme has passed over districts that needed it. Keep the people behind the story in view, and ask the hard questions without inventing answers.

variants.headline: Need goes unanswered in grant allocation
variants.body: Districts in need were passed over by a government grant programme. Keep the people behind the story in view, and ask the hard questions without inventing answers.

variants.headline: Government grants miss the districts in need
variants.body: A government grant allocation has overlooked the districts that needed support. Keep the people behind the story in view, and ask the hard questions without inventing answers.
